Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A bartender and an optometrist were talking about how they ended up in the jobs they did. The bartender recalled having a hard time before college, even not passing some classes, and the optometrist started their story talking about having been a member of the honors society back in high school. Who failed classes in high school?
A. The bartender
B. Can't be determined
C. The optometrist
